scope: Single 500-input qualification attempt; 200 development and 300 heldout cases. Historical prepared-context strata, not full-corpus generalization certification.

reference.route: existing OpenCode -> Azure Kimi; not started or silently substituted

GPT_audit.selection: 30 deterministic hash-ranked heldout cases plus up to20 hash-ranked nonduplicate disagreement cases after comparison; never filtered/refused sources
GPT_audit.judgment: independent source reading; not human gold

field_gate.unknown_reference: never a negative; report separately and in coverage denominator
field_gate.candidate_unknown_failure_or_missing: abstention, counts as missed reference positive; report failure and all-case coverage
field_gate.outcome_metrics: Per frozen outcome dimension multiclass confusion matrix and classwise macro-F1, plus explicit-positive one-vs-rest precision/recall. All predeclared heldout cases remain in accounting.
field_gate.relation_metrics: One-to-one set matching of complete frozen-schema semantic relation tuples, including object/role, strength, year/bounds and alternatives; evidence must pass exact source quotation checks. Quotes, arbitrary local item IDs and explanatory notes are not semantic tuple equality. Field only qualifies when both outcome and complete-relation gates pass where applicable.
field_gate.conditional_result: fields may pass independently; accepted historical values and unknowns never overwritten

negative_controls: Retain no-hit, unknown and ordinary failed-output strata; prior20 and all protected/retry-forbidden contexts excluded.
production_gate: Step4 remains locked until field qualification AND a provably nonduplicate missing-field queue. Neither schema pass nor agreement alone equals population accuracy.
